expected.subject: Recurring on Growth?
expected.body: There's no 'Make recurring' option under More. Why?

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

The 'Make recurring' option only appears on the Pro plan, so it won't show under More on other plans like Growth.

To get it:
1. Go to Settings > Billing > Change plan and choose Pro (R699/month).
2. Upgrades take effect immediately, and you're charged a pro-rated amount for the rest of the current month.
3. Then open any invoice, click More > Make recurring, and choose the frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly) and the start date.

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.
